map.铁路噪声控制工具按输入参数估算轮轨噪声与隔音措施效果，适合线路环评、声屏障设计与: The railway noise control tool estimates wheel-rail noise and the effect of insulation measures from input parameters, suited to preliminary estimation in line environmental assessment, noise barrier design and roadside noise control.
map.新建线路环评：按设计时速与线路条件估算轮轨噪声源强，叠加沿线背景声后校核距轨中心: Environmental assessment for new lines: estimate wheel-rail noise source strength from design speed and line conditions, then superimpose background sound along the line to check compliance at 30 m from the track center.
map.既有线声屏障设计：在轮轨声源与受声点之间设声屏障，按插入损失折算“隔音后”等效声: Noise barrier design for existing lines: place a barrier between the wheel-rail source and the receiver, convert insertion loss into an equivalent "post-insulation" level, and check the reduction at sensitive points.
map.既有建筑隔音改造：评估住宅外窗/墙体隔声量，将室内外声级差作为 B 端输入，估算: Sound insulation retrofit of existing buildings: assess the insulation of exterior windows/walls, feed the indoor-outdoor level difference in as input B, and estimate the achievable indoor level.
map.以设计时速 200 km/h 客货共线铁路估算距轨 30 m 声级: Estimate the sound level 30 m from the track for a mixed passenger-freight railway with a design speed of 200 km/h
map.：取轮轨等效声源 A=90 dB，沿线背景（风声+远场交通）B=75 dB。总声: : take the wheel-rail equivalent source A=90 dB and wayside background (wind plus distant traffic) B=75 dB. Total sound pressure level = 10 x log10(10^(90/10) + 10^(75/10)) = 10 x log10(10^9 + 10^7.5), about 90.14 dB; counting only wheel-rail (background shielded) gives 90 dB, so the background raises the total by about 0.14 dB. When B is 15 dB or more below A, the total level is essentially set by the stronger source.
map.轮轨噪声和背景噪声怎么叠加？: How do wheel-rail noise and background noise combine?
map.声压级按能量叠加而非算术相加：总声级 L = 10×log10(10^(L1/1: Sound pressure levels add by energy rather than arithmetically: total level L = 10 x log10(10^(L1/10) + 10^(L2/10)). Two equal sources add only 3 dB; when they differ by 10 dB the weaker contributes almost nothing; above 15 dB difference the weaker can be ignored. This tool uses exactly this formula to add two sound levels by energy.
map.“隔音”输入项应填什么？: What should the "sound insulation" input contain?
map.视目的而定：做声屏障设计时填“屏障后等效声级”（即扣除插入损失后的受声点声级）；: It depends on the purpose: for noise barrier design enter the "equivalent level behind the barrier" (the receiver level after deducting insertion loss); for building insulation retrofit enter the "indoor level implied by the indoor-outdoor level difference (sound insulation)". The tool only sums two sound levels by energy and has no built-in insertion loss model, so the B-side level must be obtained by other means first.
